_note: How loud and how far the QUIET hunter sounds carry: a hunter that is not chasing (wandering, investigating, searching, lingering). Chase, jump-scare, capture and grab cues never read this file. Every gain multiplies the sound's normal loudness (1.0 = unchanged); every range is in cells/metres and replaces the normal reach (silent past it). The hunter_step block in cues.json stays the chase figure (9 / 4.5 / 0.09).
